pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-03.png with Read and looked at it. Four panels: two on the top row, then two wide rows.
pages.observation: My reading order matched the layout and the exchange flows naturally. Panel 1: 'Good morning! I'd like to see the doctor.' has a short tail to the waving man with a shoulder bag at the entrance. Panel 2: 'Of course. May I register your details for today's appointment?' has a tail down to the receptionist's head. Panel 3: 'Yes, please.' has a tail to the man's face. Panel 4: 'You're all set, Ravi. Please have a seat.' has a tail to the receptionist at right. All tails reach the right speaker. Coverage: in panel 2 the left part of the balloon overlaps the top of the over-the-shoulder man's cropped head at the left edge. His face is already mostly out of frame, so this is minor. No hands, phone, monitor or keyboard are covered. The camera reverses between panels 1 and 2 (receptionist left, then right), but the over-the-shoulder framing makes that readable. No required change.
